Game Overview

In Merge Shapes, the core idea is straightforward: immerse yourself in Merge Shapes, a strategic puzzle adventure where you merge similar tiles to evolve shapes, transforming them from basic outlines into vibrant forms. As complexity grows, strategize carefully to meet goals and advance through this captivating and colorful world. Every completed shape brings you closer to victory!
